tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every column; also the sticky filter bar (`.tools`) background.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on `bg`: stat strip, tables, cards, inputs, card links. Also the text color on solid `accent` fills (pressed segment, current mobile nav pill).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg`, `paper`, `soft` and `hl` (14.7:1 / 15.7:1 light). Also the 2px rule above findings, tip columns and the side-nav home link.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg`, `paper` and `soft`: eyebrow, lede, section subtitles, labels, table headers, counts, sources (≥5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders (1px) on cards, tables, strips, inputs, tags and row dividers. Decorative separation only — never the sole boundary of an interactive control.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fill on `bg`/`paper`: table header row, table row hover, bar-chart track, procedure box, side-nav hover, "준비 중" placeholder cards.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue (navy). Links, finding keys, bar fills, focus rings (2px outline), current nav border, card-link top rule, pressed segment fill. 10:1 on `paper` light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `accent` text: hovered/pressed bar rows, current nav item, D-day chip, `mark` search hits, `.t27` year chip.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Result "최초합" (first-round pass): pill text and review-card left rule, on `pass-bg`. Light pair is 4.4:1 — just under AA for the 11.5px pill; kept exact from source.

tokens.name: pass-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind `pass` text in the 최초합 pill.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Result "충원합" (waitlist pass) pill and card rule; memo-box text on `wait-bg`. Light pair is 4.1:1 — under AA at pill size; kept exact from source.

tokens.name: wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind `wait` text: 충원합 pill and `.memo` notes.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Result "불합" pill and card rule; "soon" D-day chip; tight prep-gap warning. 4.6:1 on `fail-bg` light. Told apart from `pass` by its label text, not by hue alone.

tokens.name: fail-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind `fail` text: 불합 pill, soon D-day chip.

tokens.name: na
tokens.usage: Result "미기재" (not stated) pill and default card rule; past D-day chip text. Light pair 4.2:1 — kept exact from source.

tokens.name: na-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind `na` text: 미기재 pill, past D-day chip.

tokens.name: hl
tokens.usage: Highlighter band under `<b>` in prose (bottom 42% of the line box). Text over it stays `ink` (13.8:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: em
tokens.usage: Warning emphasis `<b class="warn">` — orange, bold — for caveats such as "합격선으로 읽으면 안 됨". 5.2:1 on `paper`, 4.8:1 on `bg` light.

families.body: "Malgun Gothic", "맑은 고딕", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. In code: clamp(1.9rem, 4.5vw, 2.7rem); this is its maximum. word-break: keep-all, text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Big tabular number in the stat strip (`.strip .v`).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text (body). Sets the 1.7 leading every block inherits.

styles.name: finding-lead
styles.usage: First paragraph of each finding row (`.find li>div>p:first-child`).

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Prose blocks, tip-column lists, finding key labels at .95rem.

styles.name: sec-sub
styles.usage: Section subtitle under h2, in `muted`, max 65ch. Also bar-chart labels, samples, inputs.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table body cells and card-link descriptions.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Pills (result), tags, D-day chips. Numbers use tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-chip
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, jump links and meta items.

tokens.name: space-list
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked review cards and list rows.

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: Gap in card-link grids, bar-chart columns, table cell padding (9px × 12px).

tokens.name: space-card-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of strips, card links, key boxes; finding row padding.

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of card links, key boxes, samples.

tokens.name: space-page-x
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (`.wrap` padding-inline).

tokens.name: space-page-top
tokens.usage: Top padding of the page wrap.

tokens.name: space-shell-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the side nav and the main column.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Margin above every `section`.

tokens.name: space-page-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the page wrap.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Bar-chart tracks and fills, result bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, D-day chips, memo and procedure boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, segmented control, buttons, nav items, bar rows.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Result pills, jump links, mobile nav pills.

tokens.name: width-side
tokens.usage: Left nav column width (desktop).

tokens.name: width-read
tokens.usage: Reading column (`.read`) and footer max width.

tokens.name: width-wrap
tokens.usage: Max width of a page without the side nav.

tokens.name: width-shell
tokens.usage: Max width of the nav + main shell.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Strip goes 2×2, findings and bar rows stack.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tip columns collapse to one.

tokens.name: bp-spgrid
tokens.usage: Key box + notes grid collapses.

tokens.name: bp-nav
tokens.usage: Side nav becomes a breadcrumb + horizontal pill row.
